exporter.schema_claim: OCCT implementation mode only; not ISO 10303-242:2025 Edition-4 certification

shape_processing.programme_healing: none during serialization; any reconciliation is explicit and measured before writer transfer
shape_processing.writer_translation_defaults: OCCT 8.0.1 defaults not otherwise overridden by the fields pinned in this profile
shape_processing.healed_fixture: healed-same-domain uses ShapeUpgrade_UnifySameDomain before export and records pre/post metrics

execution.process_isolation: one short-lived exporter process per fixture; no concurrent OCCT calls within a fixture
execution.global_state_policy: DESTEP_Parameters constructed and populated per fixture; the RCS-022 harness performs no Interface_Static mutation

layer_c_readback.session: fresh reader instance in the same short-lived fixture process after serialization
layer_c_readback.authority: Layer C only; never counted as independent Layer D evidence

parser.implementation: pure Rust universal-schema ISO 10303 Part-21 reader; no OCCT dependency
parser.limitations: parser/schema evidence only; does not replace a downstream solid-kernel import

solid_consumer.implementation: pure Rust vcad B-rep kernel STEP reader using stepperoni; no OCCT dependency
solid_consumer.declared_upstream_scope: vcad documents AP214 as its primary STEP target; RCS-022 therefore treats acceptance of the OCCT AP242DIS files as measured evidence, not assumed capability

consumer_mesh_diagnostic.authority: bounded diagnostic only; OCCT Layer-C B-rep metrics remain strict contract checks

layer_d.dependency_lock_policy: direct crate versions are exact pins; generated Cargo.lock files and cargo metadata are retained with final campaign evidence

refusal_policy: invalid/open/non-solid, non-positive material, excessive topology tolerance, missing body, unit/schema/parser/consumer disagreement are explicit rejection/unqualification conditions; no tolerance widening, healing-after-export, body dropping, or tessellated substitution is permitted
provenance_policy: every emitted STEP is SHA-256 digested and bound in campaign evidence to fixture source, exporter profile id, expected body set, and independent parser/consumer observations
rerun_triggers: OCCT exporter version or source commit
STEP schema or solid model mode
vcad STEP/B-rep consumer version or implementation
